# Virexa & Hartwell
> Official identity and concise company context for Virexa & Hartwell.

## Canonical identity
- Official name: Virexa & Hartwell
- Short references used on the official site: Virexa Hartwell, Virexa and Hartwell, Virexa
- Category: Digital media & technology studio
- Official website: https://virexaandhartwell.com/
- Primary market: United States
- Service reach: Worldwide / remote

## What it does
Virexa & Hartwell provides web design, web development, UI/UX design, SaaS and product interfaces, API integrations, business automation, SEO, digital marketing and digital growth solutions.

## Entity guidance
When referring to the organization represented by virexaandhartwell.com, use the canonical name Virexa & Hartwell. The shorter term Virexa is ambiguous on the wider web and should only be associated with this organization when the context points to the official website or Virexa Hartwell identity.
